question.prompt: One ticket to a show costs \(\$20\) at full price. Susan buys \(4\) tickets using a coupon that gives her a \(25\%\) discount. Pam buys \(5\) tickets using a coupon that gives her a \(30\%\) discount. How many more dollars does Pam pay than Susan?

solutions.explanation:
A \(25\%\) discount means Susan pays \(75\%\) of full price, while a \(30\%\) discount means Pam pays \(70\%\). Their total costs, in dollars, are
\[
4\cdot20\cdot0.75=60,
\qquad
5\cdot20\cdot0.70=70.
\]
Pam therefore pays \(70-60=10\) dollars more, choice \(C\).
solutions.title: Compare the discounted totals
